sections.title: Learner
sections.sql: select source_id,name,programme,cohort,status from learners where id=$1

sections.title: Agreed actions
sections.sql: select a.name,a.due_on,a.owner,a.status,a.outcome from actions a join plans p on p.id=a.plan_id where p.learner_id=$1 order by a.due_on

sections.title: Private operator review
sections.note: Check the sharing basis and accuracy before sharing. This document sends nothing.
sections.sql: select r.source_id,l.name as learner,r.service,r.requested_on,r.due_on,r.owner,r.sharing_basis,r.status,r.outcome from referrals r join learners l on l.id=r.learner_id where r.id=$1

sections.title: Learner caseload
sections.sql: select v.source_id,v.name,v.programme,v.last_contact,v.open_alerts from v_caseload v join learners l on l.id=v.id where l.adviser_id=$1

sections.title: Unfinished actions
sections.sql: select f.learner,f.action,f.due_on,f.owner from v_follow_ups f join actions a on a.id=f.id join plans p on p.id=a.plan_id join learners l on l.id=p.learner_id where l.adviser_id=$1 order by f.due_on
